worker is SERVING ITS DISPATCH PROBATION: it has answered 1 of 2 consecutive liveness pings since it connected, and is not selected for dispatch until the run is complete. This is the ordinary cost of connecting — every healthy worker start passes through it, on every transport — not a fault, and not a statement that anything is unreachable
